title: Saffron House
summary: Created as part of the House of Saffron exhibition at Sikka Art & Design Festival 2025, commissioned by Dubai Culture. I led the full video production, including creative direction, cinematography, editing, and final delivery. The video explores the cultural significance of saffron in Emirati heritage through a cinematic documentary approach.
